newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed weak, rains reach producing areas.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed weak, rains reach producing areas.

text.p: Indian castorseed prices on reports of widespread rain in the producing centres which raised prospects for the new crop, dealers said.
September delivery dropped further to 1,131/1,132 rupees per quintal from 1,141/1,142 rupees, floor sources said.
"Arrivals of castorseed in the producing centres remained low today due to rain, but the timely rain has also brightened new crop prospects," one operator said.
An absence of fresh overseas demand also undermined sentiment, traders said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 357/358 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes due to heavy rain in the producing centres, one miller said.
"Local demand however remained low today," he added.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil slid by 5 rupees at 545/550 rupees per 15 kg.

In Bombay, imported palm oil was steady at 267/268 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity but expectations of fresh arrivals at the Bombay port in the coming days coupled with reports of setback in the world market kept the market defensive.
